context: Tests whether the agent correctly infers the implied maintenance action for a Keep-a-Changelog file: two pending Unreleased entries should trigger a release cut, choosing an appropriate version above 2.1.0, stamping today's date, preserving wording, and leaving a fresh empty Unreleased section at the top without tagging/committing/pushing.

checklist.name: Release cut performed
checklist.description: CHANGELOG.md now contains a release version section (above 2.1.0, e.g. 2.2.0) previously absent from the file.

checklist.name: Version chosen sensibly
checklist.description: The released version is greater than 2.1.0 and does not collide with an existing version in the file.

checklist.name: Date stamped with today
checklist.description: The release heading uses today's actual date (2026-10-09 at authoring time; whatever 'date +%F' yields at run time), not a guessed date.

checklist.name: Fresh empty Unreleased restored
checklist.description: A fresh empty '## [Unreleased]' heading sits at the top of the changelog, above the new release heading, with no placeholder bullet under it.

checklist.name: Entries preserved verbatim
checklist.description: The two previously Unreleased bullets (CSV export; summary totals) now live in the new release section with their wording unchanged.

checklist.name: Prior release section untouched
checklist.description: The 2.1.0 section remains intact below the new release with its original date and entries.

checklist.name: Header intact
checklist.description: The 'The format is based on' and 'Semantic Versioning' lines are unchanged and still at the top of the file.

checklist.name: workflow.md records reasoning
checklist.description: workflow.md exists and explains which maintenance actions were taken (release cut, no other action) and references the changelog's state to justify it.

checklist.name: No invented entries
checklist.description: No new bullets were invented beyond a release cut; no extra version headings or placeholder content appeared.

checklist.name: No tag/commit/push
checklist.description: No git tag, commit, or push was made; git log still shows only the initial commit.

checklist.name: No version bump above minor
checklist.description: The version chosen is not a major bump (e.g. 3.0.0); entries are a single Added plus a Fixed, so a minor or patch bump is appropriate and nothing in the changelog justifies a major change.
